text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. To help determine the cause of your fatigue and itching, have you noticed any yellowing of your skin or eyes, or changes in the color of your urine?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of ulcerative colitis and the severe itching, I need to rule out Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis; do you have any dark urine or pale, clay-colored stools? I will also need to check for signs of liver disease, so please request an abdominal ultrasound and specific liver immunology tests like p-ANCA.

speaker: Patient

speaker: Doctor
